_comment: high vs low -- NOT a true off switch: at 'low' the model still emits
analysis-channel reasoning. The label for this model therefore reads
'more reasoning helps', not 'reasoning helps', and it must not be
pooled with the binary-toggle models without saying so.
--max-response-len is 1024 rather than 320 for exactly that reason:
at 320 the low-effort responses would truncate before the final
channel and every correct_off would read as wrong.
Thinking budgets are RAISED over the Qwen3 runs (6144/12288/8192 vs
3072/8192/6144): a 4-sample smoke on easy GSM8K truncated 1 of 4 at 2048.
Holding the token budget fixed across models does not hold the
intervention fixed -- it just starves the model that reasons longer, and a
truncated thinking pass is scored wrong, which fabricates 'thinking did
not help'. Truncation flags are recorded either way; use --drop-truncated
name: capture_gptoss20b
